'''Mirning''' (Mirniny) is a [[Pama–Nyungan languages|Pama–Nyungan language]] of [[Western Australia]].

Murunitja was apparently a dialect of either Mirning or of its sister language [[Ngadjunmaya language|Ngadjunmaya]].<ref name=AIATSIS/>
